text: A particle P oscillates in simple harmonic motion between the points A and B, where AB = 6 m. The
period of the motion is 0 s. Find the speed of P when it is 2 m from B. [3]
Two uniform small smooth spheres A and B have equal radii and masses 5m and 2m respectively.
Sphere A is moving with speed u on a smooth horizontal surface when it collides directly with sphere
B which is moving towards it with speed 2u. The coefficient of restitution between the spheres is e.
